confirmedBugs.finding: EMA200 period shortened to available candle count; 7-day hourly window cannot compute a real EMA200.
No closed-candle filter before strategy analysis; last incomplete 1h and 4h candles may drive entries/exits.
Pagination requests 1000 but breaks on fewer than 1000; installed OKX adapter caps at300. Formatter emits first300 rather than latest/history entirety. Increasing lookback alone is unsafe.
Protective exits wait for all 200 asset fetches and the 15-minute cycle; observed snapshot interval median16.47 minutes, max7.02 hours. NEAR stop filled about3.29% beyond nominal stop.

Closed-position P&L omits entry fee and stale position input overwrites cumulative partial profit. CT position31 reported43.6911 instead of87.3822 exit-net; corrected all-fee net84.8277. Cash received both fills.
Short funding directly debited from cash using fixed0.25-hour per cycle, with no per-position journal. Non-fill cash deductions26.56 are consistent with funding but cannot be exactly allocated.
Entry volume filter checks optional DEX liquidity volume instead of exchange quoteVolume; a USDG stablecoin position was opened with0.0114% ATR and lost2.75 before any funding.
Cooldown only held in process memory and disappears on restart.
Fixed8% TP2 can lie closer than1.5R TP1 for wide ATR stops; exit targets use prefill price rather than actual entry.
Run-once can launch alongside continuous agent and collide on nontransactional SQLite writes.

candidateSpecification.risk: 0.25% equity maximum modeled stop-risk; <=5% notional per position,2 positions,10% deployment, no leverage or Kelly sizing. Liquidity>=10M quoteUSD/24h, spread<=0.2%, fresh books.
candidateSpecification.exit: 2ATR stop with1.5% floor; signals reject distances above6%. Half at1.5R, remainder3R, cost-aware breakeven plus trailing afterTP1; 96h weak-position time stop. Poll open positions independently every15s plus API latency.
candidateSpecification.brakes: 4h symbol cooldown,12h after stop,24h after3 consecutive losses,1.5% daily loss /5% peak drawdown entry halts. Exits remain enabled.
candidateSpecification.accounting: Separate SQLite ledger only when explicitly run --paper. Atomic open/close, both fees included, fresh partial-close state, actual elapsed checkpointed funding, durable cooldown lookup. Default --check is read-only public market data.
candidateSpecification.testing: Fixed parameters before first replay;220 days downloaded,1000 hours reserved for warmup;4 chronological windows including last holdout, fees/slippage stress, corrected legacy replay and legacy signals with candidate risk for comparison. No optimization or promise of future returns.
